codesFaq.question: How do I redeem Loot Up codes?
codesFaq.answer: Reach the main hub, select the Social button on the left side of the screen, enter a code, then choose Claim or Redeem. Type each code exactly as shown because published sources note that codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why does a Loot Up code fail?
codesFaq.answer: Codes can expire or have changed since the last source check. Re-enter the code exactly, then test it in the live game before assuming a published list is current.

codesFaq.question: Where can players look for new Loot Up codes?
codesFaq.answer: Published guides point players to the in-game news board and official community update channels. Check the live game and official sources rather than treating any third-party list as permanent.

items.question: What is Loot Up?
items.answer: Loot Up is a Roblox action RPG by Humbling Games. Its official listing describes fighting enemies, collecting loot, upgrading gear, and enchanting weapons across new worlds and bosses.

items.question: Are the best-build pages official rankings?
items.answer: No. Stats, skills, enchantments, and armor pages separate game-system facts from player-video recommendations. They are starting points to test, not official rankings.

items.question: Why are some topics not in this wiki yet?
items.answer: This first version does not publish pages when the available sources cannot support the claim. Tier List, Pets, Races, World 6 Armor, and Awakening remain paused pending better evidence.
